# NEVERMERGE: hosted post648 package preparation only

This private experimental branch replaces its stable-release workflow with a
single guarded manual build-only job. It is never a default-branch/release
workflow. Source preparation grants no execution authority. Root must first
verify the frozen new controller and allocate ONE new hosted producer and
ordinary artifact handoff; the old local producer and SDK allocations are spent.
No dispatch, provisioning, signing, compilation or artifact upload ran during
source preparation. No ONE-Q clock/source repair is imported here.

This successor is based on actual dev
`4b852f065e2200f46c194b4ad2c5ace3fbd766a8`. It preserves the reviewed
ca919 controller on its original private branch; the manual guard now selects
only `codex/experimental-native-q-host-package-post648`. Original G1 source
clearance applies to ca919 only; affected verification must bind this successor.

`pair.json` pins final P `6c578a2c18050e218b83daf80f46731040e4b3e4`.
Its actual immediate `P_parent` is `478895c50034b3d2b200cce5391e098c7ec477ae`;
`P_native_base` is `e785f5a1c4886a55c1c6edb7f6cc1d61b54879c1` and
`source_context` remains actual dev4b852. The final product adds only two guide/
documentation corrections to P478; operational packaging/Native/Q blobs are
unchanged. The exact P commit binds that ancestry. Root's composition proof
retains all125 Native patches. Q04c hashes and SDK2cee H9863 stay unchanged.
Only P's Rust/normal Swift are built. H provides the maintained Bound/ci.run
process-group/ownership/drain/retention owner; its Rust/Auth/native cases are
never built or called. Q's exact source, inherited unchanged by P, is imported
only for strict inspect_normal_package of actual manifest/relocated post-sign
bytes. No app/XCTest/AX/console/provider/profile/R/futureStore operation exists.

Before dispatch Root supplies `package_admission` with exactly scope
`ff8-hosted-normal-package-only`, controller_sha (the actual frozen new commit),
a named allocation_id, attempt1, retries0 and clock fields STARTED,
WORK_DEADLINE, CLEANUP_DEADLINE, HARD_DEADLINE as absolute finite epochs. Placeholders
are not an admission. Original time starts before queue/checkout/bootstrap.
Maximum is40min total,30min work, at least8min cleanup and2min retention.
Every bootstrap step and maintained command is clamped to those same deadlines;
individual caps are not additive allowances. Work expiry/discontinuity stays
latched; retention can preserve a failed episode without renewing work.

Existing action pins reproduce SDK2cee checkout/Rust1.98/Node24.22.1/bootstrap
and always-retention patterns. Actual host must be Darwin arm64, image
20261102.0473.1 and the H-qualified Xcode26.6/SDK26.5/OS envelope. DEVELOPER_DIR
selects a preinstalled Xcode; no install/global xcode-select or OS setting change.
The initial original-clock gate records actual/expected ImageVersion and requires
exact equality before any checkout/bootstrap. Unknown or mismatched fleet images
stop with a FAIL receipt; no wildcard, selector change, requeue or SDK inference.
Later exact toolchain/OS/capacity checks remain required.
Before/after each phase require observed integer memory>=6GiB, free disk>=8GiB,
CPU>=2 and unchanged image; unknown/insufficient capacity stops. Cold setup and
release compilation can exhaust this finite envelope on a7GiB/14GB hosted VM.
No tool deletion, paid runner, cache rescue, automatic retry or timeout extension.

Fresh H/P make setup is bounded300s each, dependency-only for H. Only P executes
prepare-engine --track dev (1080s), normal (180s), verify --signatures (60s),
relocate-check (90s), and Q package inspection (60s), all within remaining work.
These are the unchanged P commands: one private exact-source engine and normal39
producer, ad-hoc `--sign -` nested/outer signing, strict signatures/inventory and
original unsigned plus distinct post-sign receipts. No certificate/Keychain/
identity query/DeveloperID/notary/installation or runtime action is selected.

Compiler cache is a dedicated job-temp sibling of output and never uploaded.
Owned outputs are capped512MiB; exported receipts8MiB (each JSON/log uses owning
limits). No failed/unknown cleanup is deleted or retried. Retention stages only
the unedited producer manifest and its original ZIP, bounded receipts and gate
facts, unique run/attempt artifact name,3-day retention, no overwrite. Root must
consume job/ownership PASS, exact file hashes/size/source and artifact ID before
any further admission. Artifact hashes are NEW host evidence, not required to
equal local f591/bb45; source final P6c578 and genuine invariants remain exact.
The legacy `ff8-hosted-normal-package-only` scope and temp/artifact names identify
the unchanged packaging lineage; they neither select old P nor renew an allocation.

Cross-run delivery uses ordinary pinned Actions download with exact run/artifact
ID and separately approved repository-scoped ephemeral actions:read permission;
no token/PAT creation. Extract the original ZIP with ditto into a new canonical
package root, preserving manifest/container bytes and internal modes, and repeat
strict P/Q admission. No expanded .app/profile/DerivedData is uploaded. This job
does not dispatch or authorize the separately reviewed/admitted ONE-Q case.

Required before execution: original G1 affected source verification, explicit
source-availability publication, observed capacity/image and a NEW finite Root
producer allocation. SDK-only/ONE-Q UI/signing/distribution/minimumOS/hardware
acceptance stay separate. No source push/PR/Native14/501/504/512/catalog changes
are part of this source unit; the published ff8 supplier ref remains exact.

Inert controls only:
`python3 -B -m unittest discover -s .github/scripts/native-q-host-package -p 'test_*.py' -v`
